headline: Senior Backend Engineer
summary: Results-oriented Backend Engineer with over 7 years of experience in architecting and maintaining scalable server-side applications. Specialist in API design, database optimization, and cloud infrastructure within the healthcare and fintech sectors in Nepal. Proven ability to lead technical teams and deliver high-performance solutions using Python and Node.js.

experiences.title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Lead the backend development of a large-scale health-tech platform, servicing over 50,000 active users daily.
Architected and implemented a microservices architecture using Python/Django and RabbitMQ to decouple legacy monolithic components.
Optimized PostgreSQL database performance by implementing indexing strategies and query tuning, resulting in a 35% reduction in API response times.
Mentored a team of 4 junior developers through code reviews and technical workshops on system design and clean code principles.

experiences.title: Software Engineer (Backend)
description: Developed complex ETL pipelines to process large healthcare datasets, ensuring high data integrity and security standards.
Collaborated with US-based product owners to translate business requirements into technical specifications for claims processing modules.
Integrated third-party REST APIs and implemented OAuth2 authentication protocols for secure data exchange.
Participated in the migration of on-premise services to AWS, utilizing EC2, S3, and RDS.

experiences.title: Junior Backend Developer
description: Contributed to the development of open-data portals for local government bodies in Nepal using PHP and Laravel.
Managed database schema migrations and maintained documentation for internal API endpoints.
Assisted in front-end integration using Vue.js for administrative dashboards.
